newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov wants up to seven new development zones.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov wants up to seven new development zones.

text.p: New York State Gov George Pataki on Friday said that he wanted to create up to seven new economic development zones to help regions hurt by cutbacks in military spending, but regions would have to compete for the new zones.

"Communities hit by defense cutbacks have a ready made, highly trained workforce at hand. The Economic Development Zones are another tool we can use, in partnership with local communities, to help relieve those communities by attracting business and creating jobs," Pataki said in a statement.
The present economic development program targets economically distressed areas.
